data.title: Reddit CEO says Google's AI Overviews can't replace '10 blue links' for referral traffic
data.description: Reddit CEO Steve Huffman said his company has to find ways to work around changes at Google, which is delivering less traffic than in the past.
data.author: Jonathan Vanian
